name: font_manager_generate_def_path

provenance.source: Exact .155 AP-backed IDA function with font_manager_generate_def_path name/source strings; raw function chunk independently rehashed against the pinned AP.

notes: Traverses the registry head at manager+28 with payload size at +24; returns the first matching node's path. Otherwise formats '%s/%s.ttf' from base at manager+36 into a 256-byte buffer at manager+292 and returns it. Returned storage is borrowed and may change on later calls.
